scope: ordinary Responses builder, including observed Responses V2 compaction; excludes legacy /responses/compact

standard_without_caller_instructions_or_.instructions: omitted if supplied base instructions are empty
standard_without_caller_instructions_or_.note: source-derived empty supplied content, not an empty-tool CLI capture

lite_without_caller_instructions_or_tool.instructions: top-level omitted; no developer instruction item when empty

additional_tools.id: derived from thread and supplied tool JSON; fixture ID is not a default

lite_without_caller_instructions_or_tool.note: source-derived empty supplied content; preserve existing caller input, do not inject built-in prompts/tools

parallel_source.generic_prompt_default: core/src/client_common.rs:49 is false; not normal exec

reasoning_rules: Always Some(Reasoning) in this builder; optional inner members are omitted when absent.
Effort is configured value or model default, then resolved by model.
Summary requires support and a non-None summary setting; absent in these captures.
Context omitted for standard; all_turns for Lite.
text_rules: Use supported configured verbosity, else model default.
Omit entire text when both verbosity and output schema are absent.
Output schema comes from caller; no default schema is injected.
limits: No permission to inject official agent instructions/tools follows from complete-body fixtures.
No universal reasoning/text defaults established for unknown models.
Scoped session/turn identities and metadata must not be copied literally from fixtures.
